dev.changes_summary: Wired the standard `skip` mutation into every meal-slot un-gate / select code path in scripts/lib/react_template.tpl so the `skipped:false` state survives page reload. Added SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS=Set(breakfast,lunch,dinner) plus a buildSkipMuts(...ids) helper adjacent to MEAL_SLOTS at line 2227 — the helper de-dupes, filters by SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS (excluding meals-any/accommodation/activity), and produces the canonical payload {type:'skip', slot, extra:{skipped:false, skipped_reason:null}}. Prepended ...buildSkipMuts(srcSlotId) at Site A (handleSidebarDrop ~line 2406, now 2424). Prepended ...buildSkipMuts(targetSlotId, originSlotId||null) at Site B (applyBridge ~line 2989, now 3007). At Site C, applied buildSkipMuts coverage to all SIX board-drop onDrop handlers (lines 917, 994, 1072, 1150, 1307, 1915) across all three sub-branches: `direction==='board'` prepends buildSkipMuts(payload.sourceSlotId, toSlotId) covering BOTH source and target; `direction==='candidates'` applyEditorSelection-absent fallback prepends buildSkipMuts(toSlotId); `else` setEditorSelection branch emits a separate saveMutations(day.day, buildSkipMuts(toSlotId)) only when non-empty. The four non-meal handlers (994 cafe / 1072 activity / 1150 entertainment / 1307 accommodation) become schema-safe no-ops because buildSkipMuts returns [] for non-SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS ids. MEAL_SLOTS (still containing meals-any) is preserved for UI _isCompatible checks. The two existing React-state `.skipped=false` clears at lines 2366 and 2963 are untouched. late_arrival_placeholder is never written.

tasks_completed.description: Added SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS constant and buildSkipMuts helper
tasks_completed.changes: Inserted after MEAL_SLOTS at line 2227: `const SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS = new Set(['breakfast','lunch','dinner'])` plus a buildSkipMuts(...ids) helper that de-dupes via a local Set, filters by SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(id), and emits the canonical {type:'skip', slot, extra:{skipped:false, skipped_reason:null}} payload (top-level `slot`, flags nested under `extra` — mirrors _apply_skip_mutation in save.py:107-114).
tasks_completed.rationale: MEAL_SLOTS includes the UI-only pseudo-slot 'meals-any' which is NOT a valid persisted slot key per day.schema.json (additionalProperties:false). Gating skip emits on SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS prevents a schema-invalid slots['meals-any'] key from ever being written to disk. Helper centralizes the restricted-guard + dedup logic in one place so every emit site reuses identical safety semantics.

The SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS filter inside buildSkipMuts makes handlers 994/1072/1150/1307 (cafe/activity/entertainment/accommodation) schema-safe no-ops because their toSlotId/sourceSlotId are not in {breakfast,lunch,dinner}. Substring `else if (window.setEditorSelection) window.setEditorSelection(toSlotId, payload.optionId, payload.originSlotId || null);` replaced via replace_all (grep count = 6) with `else if (window.setEditorSelection) { window.setEditorSelection(toSlotId, payload.optionId, payload.originSlotId || null); const _skipMutsElse = buildSkipMuts(toSlotId); if (saveMutations && _skipMutsElse.length) saveMutations(day && day.day, _skipMutsElse); }`

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — persistence was explicitly out-of-scope in prior cycle 20260527-062755 (in-session React-state un-gate only).
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Prior cycle added React-state writes that cleared slots[X].skipped=false in-session but emitted no skip mutation. Server's _apply_skip_mutation handler and slot_envelope schema already supported skipped:false persistence; the front-end had zero `type:'skip'` emit sites.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Closes the persistence gap by emitting the canonical {type:'skip', slot, extra:{skipped:false, skipped_reason:null}} mutation at every meal-slot un-gate/select code path, through the existing saveMutations autosave pipeline. Filtered by SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS so meals-any (UI pseudo-slot) and non-meal slots never reach disk.

recommendations: Out-of-scope but flagged for visibility: scripts/lib/server/save.py _get_or_create_slot (line 65) has no schema-allow-list check on slot_id — a defense-in-depth server-side allow-list would catch any future client bug that bypasses SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS. QA-F4 / codex F2 stage-gate edge: persisting a required meal slot as {skipped:false, selected_option_id:null} (the Site A / board-source deselect state) on an already user-selected day would trip STAGE_GATE_VIOLATION at validation time (not save time). Spec marks this as out-of-scope; the user's explicit deselect action is honored at save time. Separate cycle if/when validation-on-deselect surfaces as user-visible.
